question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** "vital".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"vital"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.
 
• We use the word vital to mean **"very important or necessary"**.
 
 
• **Example: **Calcium is **vital **for our teeth.
